evidence_state_definitions.official-docs: The API shape is supported by a first-party documentation page, but that alone is not local execution evidence.
evidence_state_definitions.native-api-tested: The installed package was imported and the named API was directly executed in a temporary directory with recorded invariants.
evidence_state_definitions.native-not-run: No native call was made; do not infer runtime availability or behavior.
evidence_state_definitions.package-absent: Distribution metadata and module import were both unavailable in the checked environment.

apis: ase.io.read(filename, index=None, format=None, parallel=True, do_not_split_by_at_sign=False, **kwargs) -> Atoms | list[Atoms]
ase.io.write(filename, images, format=None, parallel=True, append=False, **kwargs) -> None
capabilities.inputs: Path, file-like object, or format-supported structure stream; a file-like object requires explicit format.
capabilities.outputs: Atoms, list[Atoms], or a format-specific file.
boundaries: read() returns the last configuration by default; use index=':' for all frames.
write() overwrites by default and append=True can create unreadable files for formats without multi-frame support.
extxyz preserved tested site_id, initial_charges, and initial_magmoms arrays; POSCAR lost custom site_id.
A format opening successfully does not prove occupancy, charge, spin, labels, constraints, or site mapping survived.
capabilities.failure_semantics: Reader/writer exceptions, missing required format keywords, or any invariant loss block conversion acceptance.

capabilities.inputs: Atoms with finite cell, positions, and explicit per-axis PBC.
capabilities.outputs: The same mutable Atoms object with periodic components wrapped.
boundaries: Record integer image shifts before mutation; wrapped coordinates alone lose trajectory continuity.
capabilities.failure_semantics: Missing or singular cell, undeclared PBC, or mutation of a nonperiodic component blocks equivalence.

capabilities.inputs: Atoms and a 3x3 integer transformation P.
capabilities.outputs: New Atoms with cell P @ parent_cell.
boundaries: order='cell-major' and order='atom-major' produce different atom order; record the chosen value.
Propagated parent IDs are not unique child IDs; add explicit replica/image lineage.
capabilities.failure_semantics: Non-integer/singular transformations, count or volume mismatch, or absent one-to-many mapping block acceptance.

apis: ase.build.surface(lattice, indices, layers, vacuum=None, tol=1e-10, periodic=False)
ase.build.fcc111(symbol, size, a=None, vacuum=None, orthogonal=False, periodic=False)
ase.build.add_adsorbate(slab, adsorbate, height, position=(0, 0), offset=None, mol_index=0)
capabilities.inputs: Bulk/conventional lattice, Miller indices, layer count, vacuum and adsorption geometry in angstrom.
capabilities.outputs: Slab Atoms, then in-place adsorbate addition.
boundaries: Miller indices require the intended conventional cell.
Named adsorption sites are builder-specific.
The caller owns molecular orientation, termination selection, lateral-size convergence, dipole, charge, spin, and vacuum convergence.
capabilities.failure_semantics: Ambiguous termination/site/orientation, missing nonperiodic axis, or unmet size/vacuum checks blocks scientific use.

capabilities.inputs: A converged supercell and an explicitly selected stable site identifier/index.
capabilities.outputs: Mutated Atoms plus the removed Atom if pop() is used.
tested_invariants: survivor order and supplied IDs preserved
boundaries: This is graph mutation, not defect enumeration, charge-state selection, chemical-potential treatment, image correction, or finite-size convergence.
capabilities.failure_semantics: An index without a stable parent ID or an absent charge/spin/defect lineage record blocks the defect recipe.

capabilities.inputs: Format-recognized path or an MSON dictionary.
boundaries: In the tested 2026.5.18 core, Structure.to(fmt='json') writes charge, but Structure.from_file(json) reconstructed charge as 0.0; Structure.from_dict(as_dict()) preserved it.
POSCAR preserved tested geometry/order but lost site_properties and reset nonzero total charge to 0.0.
sort=True and merge_tol>0 mutate order/topology; keep both false for a representation round-trip.
Disordered Structure cannot be written as POSCAR.
capabilities.failure_semantics: Any lost/changed site ID, occupancy, charge, spin/magmom, PBC, order, lattice, or coordinate mapping makes the conversion lossy and blocks promotion.

boundaries: ASE initial_charges and initial_magmoms are per-atom initial values, not a general total-charge or spin-multiplicity contract.
Revalidate constraints, calculators, velocities, labels, oxidation states, total charge, and molecule multiplicity separately.
capabilities.failure_semantics: Absent semantic fields or non-bijective site mapping blocks equivalence even if coordinates match.

capabilities.inputs: Periodic Structure and explicit distance/angle tolerances.
capabilities.outputs: A new standardized/refined Structure; no explicit site-mapping object.
boundaries: Standard cells follow the documented convention and are not automatically an International Tables representation.
keep_site_properties defaults false because magnetic properties may not transfer.
No returned site map means the caller must build and verify one or fail closed.
capabilities.failure_semantics: Tolerance sensitivity, disorder, ambiguous mapping, or unreviewed property transfer blocks standardized output acceptance.

capabilities.inputs: Structure and scalar/vector/full integer scaling matrix.
capabilities.outputs: Mutated Structure or copy when in_place=False.
tested_invariants: count and volume multiplied by abs(det)
boundaries: The tested nonzero Structure.charge was copied unchanged instead of multiplied by determinant; require an explicit post-supercell charge policy.
Replicated site_id properties are not unique child IDs.
capabilities.failure_semantics: Missing one-to-many lineage, unexpected total-charge semantics, or count/volume mismatch blocks acceptance.

apis: SlabGenerator(initial_structure, miller_index, min_slab_size, min_vacuum_size, lll_reduce=False, center_slab=False, in_unit_planes=False, primitive=True, max_normal_search=None, reorient_lattice=True)
SlabGenerator.get_slabs(bonds=None, ftol=0.1, tol=0.1, max_broken_bonds=0, symmetrize=False, repair=False, ztol=0, filter_out_sym_slabs=True)
capabilities.inputs: Conventional bulk Structure, Miller index, slab/vacuum dimensions and Molecule; distances are angstrom unless in_unit_planes=True for slab sizing.
capabilities.outputs: Termination list, adsorption Cartesian coordinates, and new adsorbate Structure.
tested_invariants: one H added at requested Cartesian coordinate
boundaries: Termination, polarity, broken bonds, orientation, coverage, charge/spin and convergence remain reviewer decisions.
capabilities.failure_semantics: No acceptable termination, ambiguous adsorption site/orientation, or absent mapping/provenance blocks the recipe.

apis: Structure.replace(idx, species, coords=None, coords_are_cartesian=False, properties=None, label=None)
capabilities.inputs: Structure with explicit site IDs and selected indices.
boundaries: pymatgen-analysis-defects was absent and not run.
Core removal is not symmetry-aware enumeration, charge-state handling, correction, chemical-potential, or finite-size analysis.
capabilities.failure_semantics: Do not label core mutation as a validated defect workflow; missing specialized evidence blocks that claim.

apis: Molecule.get_boxed_structure(a, b, c, images=(1,1,1), random_rotation=False, min_dist=1.0, cls=None, offset=None, no_cross=False, reorder=True)
capabilities.inputs: Molecule plus orthorhombic box lengths in angstrom and explicit rotation/reorder policy.
boundaries: random_rotation=True introduces stochastic geometry; seed control is not exposed by this signature.
Molecular spin multiplicity is not a Structure field; retain it in external provenance.
capabilities.failure_semantics: Unrecorded reordering/randomness, boundary crossing, atom overlap, or lost charge/spin/site mapping blocks embedding acceptance.

apis: Chem.MolFromMolFile(filename, sanitize=True, removeHs=True, strictParsing=True) -> Mol | None
capabilities.inputs: Molfile or SMILES plus explicit sanitization/H-removal policy.
capabilities.outputs: Mol on success or None/exception on parse or sanitization failure.
boundaries: Package absent locally.
removeHs changes explicit atom inventory.
A Mol does not supply a general total spin multiplicity contract; retain formal charge, radicals, stereochemistry and external multiplicity explicitly.
capabilities.failure_semantics: None return, sanitization exception, atom-count/map loss, or unresolved charge/spin/stereochemistry blocks handoff.

apis: AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(mol, numThreads=1, maxIters=200, mmffVariant='MMFF94') -> list[(not_converged, energy)]
capabilities.inputs: Sanitized Mol with explicit H policy, fixed randomSeed, fixed numThreads and conformer count.
capabilities.outputs: A new H-expanded Mol, conformer IDs, and optimization status/energy tuples.
boundaries: Package absent locally.
Embedding is stochastic unless randomSeed is fixed.
not_converged=0 is required per optimized conformer.
Distance geometry and MMFF are initial-geometry methods, not DFT conformer-energy validation.
Coordinate arrays carry no self-describing DFT unit contract; record angstrom convention explicitly at handoff.
capabilities.failure_semantics: No conformer ID, missing MMFF parameters, nonzero not_converged, invalid atom mapping, or nondeterministic settings blocks acceptance.

apis: Chem.MolToMolFile(mol, filename, includeStereo=True, confId=-1, kekulize=True, forceV3000=False) -> None
capabilities.inputs: Mol, explicit conformer ID, stereochemistry/kekulization/V2000-V3000 policy and a new path.
boundaries: Package absent locally.
Reparse and compare atom order/map numbers, bonds/orders, formal charge, radicals, stereochemistry, conformer coordinates and explicit H count.
capabilities.failure_semantics: Writer completion without a successful invariant round-trip is not conversion acceptance.

fail_closed_when: format cannot represent a required field

acceptance: build site/image mapping at explicit tolerance
every child has parent plus replica/image lineage
fail_closed_when: replicated parent IDs are mistaken for unique child IDs
core mutation is presented as defect enumeration or formation-energy evidence
RDKit package remains absent for requested conformer work
mapping or electronic state is unresolved
